channel.title: Search on Harness Engineer
channel.description: Recent content in Search on Harness Engineer

item.title: BrowseComp
item.description: A benchmark that evaluates AI agents on locating hard-to-find information, stressing search strategy, context management, and retrieval harness design under difficult conditions.

item.title: Claude API: Web fetch tool
item.description: Analyzes Anthropic’s web_fetch tool design, which deterministically blocks the model from constructing arbitrary URLs and restricts fetches to user-provided or prior-search results, with optional domain allow-lists. A concrete case study in building exfiltration resistance into a tool’s harness rather than relying on the model.

item.title: ClawBench
item.description: A benchmark that evaluates AI agents across search, reasoning, coding, safety, and multi-turn conversation tasks, covering the breadth of harness demands in a single suite.

item.title: Harness Engineering for Language Agents: The Harness Layer as Control, Agency, and Runtime
item.description: A position paper that treats the harness layer as a first-class research object, proposes the control–agency–runtime (CAR) decomposition, and introduces HarnessCard for structured reporting of harness design and evaluation.

item.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
item.description: Anthropic’s architecture write-up for a multi-agent system with separation of roles and structured coordination.

item.title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning Acting and Planning in Language Models (LATS)
item.description: Integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search with LM value functions and self-reflection, using environment feedback for deliberate search over reasoning, acting, and planning — a search-based control pattern for agent harnesses.

item.title: Olas Predict Benchmark
item.description: A benchmark for evaluating agents on historical prediction market data, testing harness design for research, retrieval, and forecasting in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

item.title: SWE-agent
item.description: A mature research coding agent that makes the harness, prompt, tools, and environment design directly inspectable.

item.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
item.description: Generalizes chain-of-thought to a search over coherent intermediate thoughts with self-evaluation and backtracking, providing the search/backtrack primitive that many harnesses embed for tasks requiring lookahead.
